outcome: Land HMS Hermione: leave-one-sensor-out cross-validation diagnostic on M9 Stefan and M12 Zurcher fits, plus sensor calibration-floor measurement at t=0 across 7 fixtures. Determine whether the 6-22 deg C in-sample main-bake RMSE was sensor-side noise/calibration or genuine model misfit. If LOO-RMSE on held-out sensor is below 2 deg C, the verdict revises to GO (Method 3 viable); if matches in-sample, CONFIRM-information-limit stands.
success_metric: tests/_diagnose_loo_cross_validation.py runs end-to-end. For each fixture x model (M9 Stefan, M12 Zurcher 5-param), refit using N-1 in-dough sensors and predict the held-out sensor. Compute held-out RMSE per sensor; report median, max, and ratio against in-sample RMSE. Sensor calibration floor: spread of T1-T8 readings at t=0 (room temp) per fixture. Append Round 3 section to relevant baseline reports with revised verdict.
